why: B is Proposition 9.1.12 for every ep-groupoid and every branched Θ. A proves it for ep-groupoids over ℝᵐ (proposition_9_1_12_rn, rn_zero, rn_one), or under TopMultiplicity / HasGraphChartAt on the M-polyfold, which the project establishes only for ℝᵐ. A also contains the equidimensional case, the shrinking of V to a natural-representation domain, and two mixed-dimension witnesses. So A ⇒ B fails for a genuine reason: the general case (§9.6.1's measure-zero and graph-representation steps in an arbitrary M-polyfold) is not in A. Even restricted to ℝᵐ, A works with labellings of constant dimension, while B's Mᵢ are arbitrary submanifolds; matching them needs the local constancy of the dimension (Remark 9.1.1), which is not proved in general. B ⇒ A is proved. The key lemma local_of_B derives the project's DimPartsAgreeNear for any Θ (not only branched ones, as A's local versions are stated) and any two labelled structures. It restricts both structures to W = U ∩ U' and applies B to the trivial ep-groupoid of X.PObj with the auxiliary branched Θ_W(y) = ∑_{y ∈ Mᵢ∩W} σᵢ. At a support point, a structure of Θ_W is cut out by removing the Mⱼ not through it; paracompactness comes from metrizability. B's pointwise dimPartB equals the labelled dimPart, since HasDimB at y forces the label by finrank_chartTangent. All six 'proposition' conjuncts then follow. exists_naturalRep (via theorem_7_1), the equidimensional case and both witnesses are re-proved outright. In the ℝ² witness, the Proposition 9.1.12 step is replaced by local_of_B, and the tangent-sum step by the fibre count with ℝᵐ tangent slices. Universes at 0.
B_issue: Minor, harmless: B takes both structures on the same U (literal reading; the restriction remark reduces different domains to this). It uses the pointwise dimension dim T_yMᵢ instead of a constant dimension per Mᵢ; this agrees with the text when each Mᵢ has one dimension.

No TopMultiplicity / §9.6.1 lemma (Appendix.lean) is reused: the six proposition conjuncts come from B.
